_comment: Values to enter in Google Connected Console (Create app). Not read by any tool; kept here as the single source of truth for the Gemini listing.

app.name: Wapliss
app.description: Read and send messages from your own WhatsApp in Gemini: chats, groups and latest messages, with your confirmation before anything is sent.
capabilities: Find and read your WhatsApp chats and groups
Summarize who said what in a group
Show your latest received and sent messages
Send texts, images, documents, audio, video, locations, contact cards and polls
example_prompts: @Wapliss show me my latest WhatsApp messages
@Wapliss what did people say in my family group today?
Send 'On my way, 10 minutes' to +1 555 010 2030 with Wapliss

es-419.description: Lee y envía mensajes desde tu propio WhatsApp en Gemini: chats, grupos y últimos mensajes, con tu confirmación antes de enviar.
capabilities: Buscar y leer tus chats y grupos de WhatsApp
Resumir quién dijo qué en un grupo
Ver tus últimos mensajes recibidos y enviados
Ver participantes y administradores de un grupo
Enviar textos, imágenes, documentos, audio, video, ubicaciones, contactos y encuestas
example_prompts: @Wapliss mostrame mis últimos mensajes de WhatsApp
@Wapliss ¿qué se dijo hoy en mi grupo de la familia?
Mandá 'Llego en 10 minutos' a +54 9 11 5555 0100 con Wapliss

access_credentials.refresh_tokens: Not rotated for Google redirect URIs (Persistent Linking); 30-day sliding expiry

test_account.credentials: Entered by the owner in the console. Use a dedicated demo account (email and password, no 2FA), never a personal one.
test_account.seed_data: Demo WhatsApp number permanently linked, with the individual chat 'Demo Contact' and the group 'Demo Group' (3 participants, recent messages).
instructions: Sign in at wapliss.com with the demo email and password (not Google).
On the consent screen, click Authorize.
Try: '@Wapliss show me my 5 most recent WhatsApp chats', '@Wapliss summarize Demo Group', '@Wapliss send "Test" to Demo Contact' (confirm when asked).
Send test messages only to Demo Contact.
